examples.arabic: هي في الآخر سابتني أختار اللي عجبني ودخلنا محل تاني
examples.english: In the end, she let me choose what I liked, and we entered another store.
examples.transliteration: Heya fel akher sabetny akhtar elly 3agabny we dakhalna mahal tany

examples.english: My maternal aunt is helping me choose the dress.
My mother helps me choose the dress.

examples.arabic: يا رب يسمحلي اختار المرة دي
examples.english: I hope he allows me to choose this time!
examples.transliteration: Ya rab yasmahly akhtar el marra de!
